title: Saddle craft
description: Makes saddle craftable in older Minecraft versions
body:
This mod finally makes saddle craftable in Minecraft 1.21.5 and lower without any extra steps.

**Main features:**

- Adds a balanced original recipe for saddle

- Simple and perfect for your survival world
